elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The formula uses all Customer amounts under the Agreement, rather than fees, and measures the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, rather than the claim itself.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for the listed indirect and consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims and therefore excluded from the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data-protection or security obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore uncapped.
A party's indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore uncapped.
Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.
Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.
Fraud is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 excludes only undisputed Fees for conforming Services, not all Customer payment obligations.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: One prong of the cap uses all Customer amounts paid or payable under the Agreement during a 12-month period; the USD 1,000,000 floor does not eliminate that 12-month basis.
